name: Sonnet contrarian turnarounds
strategy: Fade H1's extremes: buy the AI-disruption-fear and macro-beaten-down names with real turnaround catalysts (ADBE/CRM/PYPL, oversold crypto, small caps, gold), while trimming the most overextended momentum trade (SOXL) short.

positions.thesis: Turnaround catalyst confirming (FTC cleared Topaz Labs deal, stock near 2-month highs, +5.7% on 7/29) but MS just cut target to $240 (below the $263 spot) — modest add, protecting gains with a tight take-profit given valuation risk after the sharp recovery from H1 lows.
Agentforce-driven re-rating underway (+19.3% in the past month) validating the depressed-multiple turnaround call; sizing up modestly given still-mixed analyst sentiment on AI growth.
Q2 beat ($1.38 EPS / $8.68B rev) supports the restructuring thesis, but the stock is only +0.6% YTD and Goldman remains at Sell $50 — holding size, turnaround thesis intact but not yet dramatic.

Highest-conviction call in the book: the leveraged-melt-up-into-correction thesis has become a confirmed, accelerating crash (-42.9%/1mo, -61.1%/3mo, 'chip crash exposing the brutal cost of leverage'). Doubling down while the trend is still working, with a stop to cap squeeze risk after such a large realized move and a take-profit to bank further downside.
Oversold-bounce thesis starting to confirm (+6.3% in the past month off a -26.9% YTD trough); adding to the position as the deep bear shows first signs of a bottom.

Strongest crypto rebound of the book (+25.0% in the past month off the worst YTD drawdown, -33.8%); the laggard-to-leader dynamic is playing out exactly as the turnaround thesis called for — sizing up.

The small-cap catch-up has essentially already happened (current +19.5% YTD roughly matches the +19.4% level noted when this book was set) and is now pulling back (-3.5%/1mo) — trimming to fund higher-conviction names.
Gold has gone essentially nowhere since inception (-6.4% YTD vs -6.5% noted then, +0.7%/1mo) — the contrarian catalyst hasn't materialized yet; trimming to a small watch-size position.

reassessment_note: Unrestricted-retail resize (2026-07-30, free internet + no sizing caps): SOXL short is the standout call — the 'first signs of correction' thesis has become a confirmed, still-accelerating chip-sector crash (-42.9%/1mo, -61.1%/3mo) — sizing up materially from 10% to 20% with stops to guard against a squeeze after such a large realized move. ADBE and CRM turnaround theses are validated (big recent rallies, FTC clearance, Agentforce traction) but I'm tempering the size increase given ADBE now trades above Morgan Stanley's fresh $240 target and CRM sentiment stays mixed — modest adds only, with take-profits to lock in gains. BTC and especially ETH are showing the oversold-bounce thesis starting to work (ETH +25% in a month off the worst YTD drawdown), so I'm adding to both with a protective stop in case the crypto bear resumes. IWM's catch-up thesis has essentially already played out (current +19.5% YTD roughly matches the +19.4% noted at inception) and is now pulling back, and GLD has gone nowhere since inception (-6.4% YTD vs -6.5% then) — both trimmed to fund higher-conviction ideas. Raising cash buffer to 12% given the larger short position.
research_notes: Checked live prices/performance (as of 2026-07-29 close) for every held name. XLU $45.52 (YTD +6.6%, -1.5% 1mo — pausing). XLY $112.48 (YTD -6.8%, still the weak sector). SOXL short (also held here) shows the same accelerating -42.9%/1mo, -61.1%/3mo crash noted above — the single best-performing thesis across both books.
